Oneliner

Multiple tethered femto-satellites with tiny thrusters for technology demonstration.
Description

Multiple tethered femto-satellites with tiny thrusters and magnetic torquers to test command and control architecture and hardware, formation keeping and reconfiguration control algorithms, communications protocol and data relay, and imaging of the Earth's surface.
